prompt:
Edit Image 1 into a clean production master for a weighted 2D skeletal animation rig. Preserve the exact same single Vivhite character, facial identity, silver-white bob, violet-pink eyes, round gold glasses, blue butterfly, costume design, body proportions, complete three-quarter screen-right combat stance, open raised screen-right palm, lowered far hand, separated legs, framing and scale from Image 1. Images 2 and 3 are authoritative identity references. Do not redesign or repose her. Change only the edge and illumination treatment described below.

Redraw the character with crisp polished 2D cel-animation rendering, controlled flat color shapes, restrained interior cel shadows, matte non-emissive surfaces, neutral even illumination, solid near-opaque skin and costume interiors and a tight clean outer contour. Preserve every real hair strand, finger, costume edge and butterfly edge that belongs to her physical silhouette. Every color, highlight and shadow must stop exactly at that physical contour. Outside the physical contour, render no painted marks at all.

Remove all existing baked light surrounding the character, especially the broad white-gray-violet fringe around the hair, butterfly, face, shoulders, hands, fingers, skirt, stockings and boots. Remove all detached edge haze and all faint non-character marks. Keep the open spaces between fingers, arms and torso, skirt and hands, both legs and hair locks completely clear wherever there is no physical character material.

Exactly one character and exactly the unchanged pose from Image 1. No weapon or held object of any kind. No sword, blade, staff, wand, rod, spear, spellbook, shield or orb. No backlight, rim light, aura, outer glow, bloom, radiance, luminous outline, soft edge light, airbrushed fringe, fog, haze, mist, smoke, particles, magic circle, spell arc, floating crystal, floor, contact shadow, cast shadow, scenery, environment, decorative frame, typography, logo, signature or watermark. No color wash, detached light or painted pixels beyond the physical character contour. No character sheet, turnaround, sprite sheet, panel grid, inset image, duplicate pose, alternate costume or multiple views. No extra person, extra limb, duplicated hand, duplicated finger, missing finger, long white ribbon, silk strip, bandage, helmet or heavy armor.
